avis.texte: The COSRX Snail Mucin Sheet Mask is a skincare product that falls into the sheet mask category, and it's part of the popular COSRX brand known for its effective and gentle skincare solutions. After using this sheet mask, here's a review based on my experience. The COSRX Snail Mucin Sheet Mask comes in a box of 10 individually wrapped sheet masks. The packaging is clean and simple, with a graphic of a snail, which represents the key ingredient - snail mucin. Each mask is sealed to maintain freshness and ensure it's sanitary for use. The sheet masks are easy to use. Each mask is generously soaked in snail mucin essence, and the sheet itself is made of soft, thin material that adheres well to the face. The mask has precut holes for the eyes, nose, and mouth, which makes it fit most face shapes comfortably. The sheet mask also comes with a plastic backing that can be removed to reveal the sheet soaked in essence. Snail mucin, also known as snail secretion filtrate, is the star ingredient of this mask. Snail mucin is believed to have various skincare benefits, including hydration, soothing, and promoting skin repair and regeneration. It's suitable for addressing a wide range of skin concerns, making it a versatile ingredient in skincare. After using these masks, I noticed a significant boost in hydration and skin suppleness. Snail mucin is known for its ability to provide intense moisture to the skin, and these masks delivered on that front. My skin felt plump, refreshed, and hydr

avis.titre: Amazing Hydration, but a Bit Too Slimy with Excess Essence
avis.texte: The COSRX Snail Mucin Sheet Mask is one of the most hydrating masks I’ve ever used. My skin feels so soft and plump after each use, and it gives me that dewy glow I absolutely love. The snail mucin is great for boosting moisture and repairing skin, which makes this sheet mask perfect for anyone dealing with dry or dull skin. However, I did find that there’s almost too much essence in each mask—so much that it tends to drip and get a bit messy. While I appreciate the extra hydration, it feels like a lot of it goes to waste, and the texture is definitely on the slimy side. I wish they could balance the amount of mucin better to avoid that overly sticky feeling. Despite that, the results are worth it, and I usually pat in any extra essence on my neck and arms, so it’s not completely wasted. Overall, if you’re looking for an intensely moisturizing mask, this one will definitely do the trick—just be prepared for a little slime overload.

A little goes a long way, so I can see this lasting me quite a while. **Final Thoughts**: Overall, I highly recommend the [Face Mask Brand/Type] to anyone looking to pamper their skin. It’s become a staple in my skincare routine, and I can’t wait to try more products from this brand. If you're in need of a little self-care, this mask is definitely worth a try!

What I like most is that the essence just works better for my skin needs. Everyone is different & I have noticed that snail mucin happens to be what my drier and more mature skin loves. avis.titre: A little slimy, but skin feels soft and hydrated afterwards.
avis.texte: I am new to this Korean skincare/beauty brand, but had read several glowing reviews, especially about the Snail Mucin Sheet Mask, I decided to give it a go. Up front, the mask is slimy which shouldn’t come as a shock given its main ingredient (96%) is the slimy secretion produced by snails. Best not to think about that, and no, snails are not harmed to extract the slime. Downside: Because the mask is slippery, it can be tricky to apply, and there is a lot of mucin, so much so, I apply the extra to my arms and hands. Even so, it can feel a tad sticky, but there is very little scent. Upside: One of the most hydrating, moisture boosting masks I’ve used, and my skin really does feel soft and look brighter afterwards. Sheets come in packs of ten and I think the cost is reasonable and the results, very good. I use the mask either at night before bed, or before an event to brighten and plump my skin.

avis.titre: Really impressive mask! Good for mature skin.
avis.texte: I have used far more expensive facial masks similar to this one (with the exception of no snail mucin) and haven’t had nearly the great results as I had with this after one use. I’m 58 and although I have taken good care of my skin, I’m still fighting fine lines and crepey skin especially around my eyes as well as redness and fine lines which are more pronounced in cold weather. I attached two images to show how effective this mask was in the areas of my concern: around eyes, eyelids, and you can see the redness in the first photo on my forehead, as well as general dryness (obviously there is no filter on these). Here’s a few tips: Yes it can be challenging to get the mask out at first, but if you leave the packaging standing upright it helps keep the contents from dripping out. I found the mask to be a bit large near my hairline so using small fabric scissors I cut two pieces out in a half mood shape (it’s easy because the “moon” of the half moon is already there at the top of the mask). I used these small pieces on my eyelids (but was careful not to get any product in my eyes). I also cut slits into the mask near my inner eyes and any areas that gapped so it would lie flat. What I liked: pretty decent results after one use especially on mature skin. Even without moisturizer after my skin feels really soft. It's only my second day using, so I don't know if there's any long term effects, but in the short term it's pretty nice! My skin definitely looks dewier afterwards. Although in person my skin texture almost looks more prominent or noticeable probably because it becomes shinier so the bumps on my forehead are there more. I didn't use a filter or make-up, just some chapstick on the second one, on the pictures so you could see the actual after effect. So about the product. It's not really good smelling, not bad though either. It smells kind of medical like. It's SLIMEY, as one would expect honestly. There is a lot of product left on my face after so I bring it down to my neck also, and massage it into my face. After it dries it's sticky for a minute but settles in nicely to a very very slightly sticky softness. I feel like this would be a good facemask for before makeup because I feel like it'd give a really well blended like soft type of look. Hope that helps!

DECEPTIVE SELLER! Ingredients list in product description is different from the ingredients list in the product received (see pics). The listing leads the buyer to believe that snail mucin is the main (first) ingredient, but that is not the case - it is the actually the 4th ingredient, diluted by water, butylene glycol, and glycerin. Seller needs to update the ingredients list in the listing to accurately reflect what is in the product. This mask is slimy (as expected) but this formulation sits on top of your skin, leaving a sticky, tacky feeling for about an hour after peeling off the face sheet. I don't think it absorbed but rather just dried on the skin surface and did not leave a fresh, hydrated feeling on my skin.
